helen (Finance Ops): Heads up — quick procurement update for the upcoming fiscal close. Please read and RT if it affects your team.
helen (Finance Ops): 1) Renewal grace window: subscriptions expiring between Apr 20–Apr 27 will have a 7-day grace for PO/CC updates to avoid service interruptions. Do NOT assume auto-renew during that window without approval.
helen (Finance Ops): 2) Micro-purchases (< $2,500): teams may use the departmental p-card but must attach a short justification in Concur and tag the project code.
helen (Finance Ops): 3) Vendor approval path change: new vendors now require Vendor Risk quick-check for amounts >= $15k. For < $15k, use the fast-track form (link below).
finance-bot: Automated link: Updated procurement playbook -> https://confluence.redwood/procurement/playbook (v2.1)
ajay (Eng): Quick Q — our monitoring SaaS renews Apr 22 for ~$1,800. So that falls in the grace window and under micro-purchase rules, right?
maria-s (Product): tagging @helen — we have a quarterly analytics sub that is $3,200 renewal Apr 23. How do we handle >$2,500 but < $15k? Is that a standard PO?
helen (Finance Ops): @ajay yes — $1,800: p-card + Concur note is fine. For $3,200 (maria-s) open a short PO request in the procurement form; finance will route it for manager signoff. Expect 48–72h turnaround if the form is complete.
samir (Infra): If a renewal is mission-critical and approval might miss the grace window, what's the escalation path? Pager duty or a human-in-the-loop email?
helen (Finance Ops): Escalation: include "procurement:urgent" in the form and DM me + @samir. We'll triage and can temporarily approve a charge pending the formal PO for infra-critical services.
maria-s (Product): thanks — will start the PO now.
ajay (Eng): thx, will attach Concur note after charge.
helen (Finance Ops): Reminder: any vendor onboarding for dedicated contracts still needs legal review. Fast-track only applies to renewals and small purchases. See the subsection "Fast-track exceptions" in the playbook.
finance-bot: Policy snippet: "Micro-purchase approval requires: (a) Project code, (b) Short business justification, (c) Receipt within 5 business days." Full doc: https://confluence.redwood/procurement/playbook#micro-purchase
samir (Infra): noted. appreciate the heads-up :thumbsup:
helen (Finance Ops): I'll post a short checklist in #general and follow up with a quick Loom walkthrough for the procurement form later today. Ping me if you need a hand. :wave:
